experiment: EXP-3 of max 3 (follows falsified EXP-1 G79-MFX and EXP-2 G79-ECE)
motivation: EXP-2 measured that geophysical corridors enrich withheld-fault density by only 1.06-1.22x and that corridor-only coverage scores 0.044 against a 0.069 budget-matched uniform control; EXP-1 measured that catalogue-template matched filtering has no skill (0.050 vs 0.051). The two readings of 'where are the unmapped faults' - splays/parallels adjacent to mapped traces, versus blind basin faults far from any trace - are mutually exclusive hypotheses about the hidden test, and the local instrument can only reward the first.
hypothesis: A fixed 50/50 portfolio emission - half the dot budget as a 3 px lattice in the 3-12 px collar around the mapped catalogue (the regime the holdout does validate) and half as a 3 px lattice inside the coherence/tilt corridors beyond 12 px (the regime only the hidden test can score) - keeps the holdout-demonstrable coverage benefit while remaining spatially unlike every informative prior raster in the registry.
mechanism: collar = 3 <= distance_to_catalogue <= 12 px and ~catalogue; corridors = EXP-2 primary region R and distance_to_catalogue > 12 px; each arm gets exactly 20000 dots from a quasi-hexagonal 3 px lattice, taken in raster order (no classifier, no score ranking); emit as binary 1.0.
named_non_fault_process: Collar arm: road/rail/fence lineaments and digitisation offsets parallel to mapped traces. Corridor arm: shallow volcanic contacts and dyke swarms (unchanged from EXP-2). Both are stated costs, not claimed rejections.

prediction_written_before_measurement.holdout: collar arm alone > uniform control at 20000 dots; hybrid pooled DTI > uniform at 40000 dots; neither expected to exceed the frozen THVC incumbent
prediction_written_before_measurement.novelty: hybrid max forward overlap vs informative (<=200000-dot) priors <= 0.70

decision_rule.promote: hybrid beats uniform on both seeds AND clears the informative-prior overlap rule AND passes the official format validator
decision_rule.negative: otherwise the card records a negative and the artifact is released only as a labelled probe
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_changes: no retuning of collar width, arm budget, lattice pitch or corridor thresholds after seeing a score
